WITH w AS (
 SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE (f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2,3)) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-12-21'),
dups AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c FROM w GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1),
recon AS (SELECT o.web_order_id, o.order_total_gross, sum(w.gross_amount) g, count(*) n, max(o.line_count) lc FROM fact_web_order o JOIN w ON w.receipt_id=o.web_order_id GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM dups) AS dup_keys,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM recon WHERE abs(order_total_gross-g)>0.05) AS total_mismatch,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM recon WHERE n<>lc) AS linecount_mismatch,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM recon) AS orders,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM w WHERE abs(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)-gross_amount)>0.05) AS vat_mismatch,
 (SELECT count(distinct etl_loaded_at) FROM w) AS loads,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM w WHERE net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0) AS nonpos

WITH w AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, o.fulfilment_type FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE (f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2,3)) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-12-21'),
r AS (SELECT w.sales_line_id, sum(rl.refund_net) AS refund_net FROM w JOIN fact_return_line rl ON rl.sales_line_id=w.sales_line_id GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type, sum(w.net_amount) AS net, coalesce(sum(r.refund_net),0) AS refunds_on_these_lines, count(r.sales_line_id) AS returned_lines
FROM w JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=w.sale_date LEFT JOIN r ON r.sales_line_id=w.sales_line_id
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, o.fulfilment_type, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE (f.channel_code = 'WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2, 3))
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
), refunds AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period,
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN net_amount END) / sum(net_amount), 2) AS cc_share_pct,
  round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN net_amount - coalesce(r.refund_net,0) END) / sum(net_amount - coalesce(r.refund_net,0)), 2) AS cc_share_after_returns_pct,
  sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN net_amount END) AS cc_net, sum(net_amount) AS web_net
FROM web_lines w LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.sales_line_id = w.sales_line_id
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2
